content: {"phoneNote":"The hours block renders five identical full-width teal bars on a faint grid, turning a one-line fact into a tall repetitive section that pushes the treatment story and prices far down.","desktopNote":"Large dead bands dominate the lower page: empty space under the hero text, a gap between the about photo and prices, and a booking section whose right half is blank.","phone":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"desktop":{"impression":3,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":2,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":3},"fixes":["Replace the gantt-style hours chart with a compact two-column list (Pon–Pet 7.00–20.00, note below); on desktop pair it with the address/map so the section earns its height.","Tighten vertical padding across sections and fill the booking band on desktop with the phone number and address instead of leaving the right half empty.","Drop the duplicated 'Fizioterapija Pregib' line under the giant footer wordmark and make 'Naročite se na obravnavo' the single styled button in the hero, leaving 'Pokličite' to the header bar only."],"blockers":[]}
